sources: Mohammed Ali al-Ansar Allah, member of the Ansar Allah' political bureau / Supreme Political Council, Telegram post, as reported by Gulf News liveblog and Times of Israel liveblog; fuller remarks via Al Mayadeen English (UNREGIST
fault_line: Does Egypt defending Saudi Arabia mean Egypt is now at war with Yemen — or is it defensive support inside Saudi borders that keeps Egypt out of Yemen, as Sisi claims?

sections.what_happened: Al-Ansar Allah: 'Egypt and its parliament declared support for what is called the defence of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and in doing so, it declares war against the Republic of Yemen.' In fuller remarks he warned against drawing Egyptian forces 'once again, as happened in the 1960s, into a war that drains their capabilities', said such attrition would serve Israeli plans on Sinai, urged Egypt, Turkiye and Pakistan not to support aggression/blockade/occupation against Yemen, and said Yemen poses no threat to Bab el-Mandeb and protects it and the Suez Canal. He added: 'We are not afraid of any alliance that takes shape.'
sections.what_verified: 2 distinct declared-tier publisher families reporting the same Telegram post: Gulf News (T3) + Times of Israel (T3). Al Mayadeen English carries fuller remarks but has NO declared tier in the registry and is NOT counted. The quote itself is a PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM (al-Ansar Allah's own post); 'declaration of war' is his characterisation, not a legal declaration by Egypt.
sections.what_disputed: Egypt has not declared war on Yemen and has not attacked Yemen: President Sisi said support is to 'defend Saudi territory, and does not include an attack on Yemen' (Dawn/Reuters, 1300-02); no formal Saudi request for Egyptian troops has been announced; Egypt is not a Mecca pact member. Al-Ansar Allah's Sinai-displacement claim is his own allegation, unattributed to any document.
sections.why_matters: Ansar Allah-Saudi proven set: 'Egypt votes in — Ansar Allah call it war.' Lead with al-Ansar Allah's exact quote, then Sisi's defensive-only line as the counterweight; the 1960s Yemen quagmire warning is the hook history.
sections.context: Background: NEW IN-WINDOW (Gulf News liveblog 12:33 ; Times of Israel liveblog 08:29 UTC = 12:29 ) -- Ansar Allah official Mohammed Ali al-Ansar Allah calls Egypt's parliament vote to authorise military support for Saudi Arabia a 'declaration of war' against Yemen; warns against luring Egyptian forces into a draining Yemen war as in the 1960s

totw_analysis: Our read: Ansar Allah-Saudi proven set: 'Egypt votes in — Ansar Allah call it war.' Lead with al-Ansar Allah's exact quote, then Sisi's defensive-only line as the counterweight; the 1960s Yemen quagmire warning is the hook history.
